name: agentic-vault
description: Shared Markdown memory, bounded session context, source-attributed recall and verified backups for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Shared file-based memory for Codex and Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.19.0: shared Markdown memory with source-bound compact constraints, opt-in bilingual query expansion, warning-first lint, host capture provenance, cooperative partial edits, temporal ledgers, lesson deltas, literal compile coverage and explicit measured token calibration. Model calls and provider adapters remain opt-in. Jev is advisory; source hashes and receipts are data, not authority. Existing vault data, permissions and default budgets remain under host control. Jarvis retains its API authentication requirement and host-selected context with no model tools.
defaultPrompt: Use agentic-vault to restore this vault's session context.
Use agentic-vault to find the sources for our last deployment decision.
